name: Herdr Agents
author: Paul Bennett
description: Live Herdr agent status in the Omarchy bar: every agent's state, current activity, workspace, and click-to-focus.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: every Herdr agent's live state, current activity, workspace, and click-to-jump straight into the Herdr window.

schema.label: Snapshot refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the plugin polls the Herdr session snapshot.

schema.label: Notify when an agent needs attention
schema.description: Show a desktop toast when an agent enters the blocked (waiting for input) state.

schema.label: Notify when an agent finishes background work
schema.description: Show a desktop toast when a working agent transitions to done.

schema.label: Fallback Herdr window class
schema.description: Terminal window class used to find the Herdr window when its process tree cannot be inspected locally (e.g. Herdr over SSH in a local terminal). Leave empty to disable. Example: ghostty
